description: Call this when the user asks until when they can contest (request a review of) their property assessment in a Quebec municipality, which assessment roll is in force, when the next roll comes, or what the reference date is. Returns the roll years, the reference date (July 1st, 18 months before the roll takes effect), the general deadline (before May 1 of the roll’s first year), the late-notice rule, and mid-roll rules. Compiled by Payotte from the official Quebec rolls (MAMH open data). For other provinces, pass `province` (e.g. "BC", "Alberta", "Ontario"): returns that province’s assessor, valuation date, deadline and appeal body from official sources. Tell the user their assessment notice prevails. Does not say whether an assessment is too high.

date_avis.description: Optional: mailing date printed on the assessment notice (YYYY-MM-DD), to apply the 60-day late-notice rule.

municipalite.description: Quebec municipality, e.g. "Drummondville", "Gatineau", "Montréal" (not needed outside Quebec).

province.description: Province code or name (BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, QC, NB, NS, PE, NL). Default: Quebec (then `municipalite` is used).
